# CV Match Coach – ChatGPT skill

Upload a consultant CV and a client request. You get an honest match, gaps, an experience check per skill, and an improved, human-sounding CV, as a **Word file in exactly the same format as the original** (same fonts, sizes and layout) or as texts to paste back into Cinode.
**It never invents facts.** If something is unclear, it asks.

## Setup (once, about 2 minutes)

1. **[⬇ Download cv-match-coach.zip](https://github.com/caelen-knowit/cv-skill-chatgpt/raw/main/cv-match-coach.zip)**

   <!-- checksum:start (generated by tools/build.py – do not edit by hand) -->

   ```
   2ac1f6f13412e244109e5f71c2eeec8d8055d2aa81442810d9eaa05bf44c1f86
   ```

   The result must match (upper/lower case doesn't matter). All checksums: [CHECKSUMS.txt](CHECKSUMS.txt).

2. In ChatGPT: **Plugins → Skills → Create → Upload from your computer**, and choose the zip.
3. **••• → Share** the skill with your team (or the whole workspace). Colleagues then don't need to install anything.

Can't see *Skills*? Ask your ChatGPT admin to enable it. Until then, use the [Project fallback](docs/setup-alternatives.md).

## Try it without installing or downloading

Open a new chat and paste:
```
Open https://raw.githubusercontent.com/caelen-knowit/cv-skill-chatgpt/main/cv-match-coach-all-in-one.md and read the whole file. Follow its SKILL.md part exactly as your instructions for this whole chat, using the other parts as the reference files. To confirm you read everything, tell me the last line of the file. Then run "Start CV Match Coach".
```
- If ChatGPT replies with the last line `END-OF-CV-MATCH-COACH <version>`, it read the whole file. If it can't open the link or gives a different last line, use the fallback below.
- This needs the repo to be **public** and **web search/browsing enabled** in your workspace.
- **Fallback:** download [`cv-match-coach-all-in-one.md`](cv-match-coach-all-in-one.md), attach it to the chat and use the same prompt, replacing "Open <link>" with "Read the attached file".
- It only works in that chat. For daily use, install the skill as above.

## Use

Open a new chat and type:
```
Start CV Match Coach
```
(Swedish: `Starta CV Match Coach`.) It asks what you want to do and then guides you step by step: attach the CV, paste the request, and so on.

Already have everything? Attach the CV (a **Word** export from Cinode, needed for exact-format output), paste the client request, and type `Match this CV to this assignment`.
After that, **just follow the menu**. Every answer ends with the next steps, the AI's recommended next step, and heads-ups when it spots something. Reply with a letter:
```
Progress: ✓ CV read → ✓ Match → ◻ Questions → ◻ CV → ◻ Cinode/Word
A – Answer the questions above
B – Experience check on the requirements
C – Suggest changes to the CV
D – Something else
💡 My suggestion: A, because 3 open questions affect the score.
```
Lost? Type `help` at any time.

You can also type commands directly:

| Type | You get |
|---|---|
| `Match this CV to this assignment` | Score, gaps, and questions to answer |
| `Experience check: Java, Azure` | Proven years/months per skill |
| `Suggest changes` | A list of improvements. Reply `apply 1, 3`. |
| `Improve CV: light` / `medium` / `heavy` | A rewritten CV (small, medium or big changes) |
| `Cinode` | The new texts, ready to paste into Cinode |

Swedish works too: `Matcha`, `Erfarenhetskoll`, `Föreslå ändringar`, `Förbättra CV: lätt / mellan / mycket`.

**Always read the result before sending it to a client.**
